entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: A vampire Maestro assassin, museum keeper and self-styled artist of murder, who is father of the bride on the day of his daughter Errant's wedding.

entities.name: Errant
entities.description: Anhelo's daughter, who is marrying Toluz's daughter Parnesse.

entities.name: Toluz
entities.description: An Obscura information broker with a shadow generator and a cane, mother of Parnesse, who demands Anhelo kill Fiero in exchange for information.

entities.name: Parnesse
entities.description: Toluz's daughter, who is marrying Errant and was injured by Fiero.

entities.name: Fiero Vespin
entities.description: A garish Maestro art dealer who was secretly plotting to ruin the wedding and had attacked Parnesse.

entities.name: Evelyn
entities.description: An old, cunning vampire of the Maestros who trades favors, and who supplies Anhelo with the Old Capennan Warrior.

entities.name: Severo
entities.description: A man who impersonates a cab driver to avenge his father, whom Anhelo killed three years earlier; he crashes the car into a Riveteer transport.

entities.name: Serena
entities.description: Errant's late mother, who is mourned by Anhelo.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: The vampire crime family to which Anhelo and Fiero belong.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: The gray-clad crime family to which Toluz belongs.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A crime family whose Halo shipment Severo was running and whose toughs attack Anhelo.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: A New Capenna family whose fees are lower than Toluz's.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The plane with competing crime families.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The beautiful top level of the city.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: A level of New Capenna where Maestros are being lost.

entities.name: Maestros' Museum
entities.description: The museum Anhelo runs, where he stages Fiero's death.

entities.name: Grand Capenna Hall
entities.description: The venue of Errant and Parnesse's wedding.

entities.name: Old Capennan Warrior
entities.description: A towering warrior statue or armor with an axe for an arm, used in the museum's Old Capenna exhibit to behead Fiero.

entities.name: Shadow Generator
entities.description: A gadget that Toluz won, which lets her bring darkness and strike unseen.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A potent substance of New Capenna smoked and drunk by its people and smuggled by the Riveteers.

events.summary: On the eve of his daughter's wedding, Anhelo takes Errant to a rundown neighborhood to buy information from Toluz.
events.quote: "Art's everywhere, if you know where to look,"

events.summary: Toluz agrees to tell Anhelo about the woman in white only if he kills Fiero Vespin, who has attacked her daughter Parnesse, by tomorrow's wedding.
events.quote: "If you want information for your Family, you have to do a little work for ours. Bump him off, and we'll talk,"

events.summary: Toluz reveals Fiero plans to use twenty goons to ruin the wedding, and Anhelo accepts the job.
Anhelo sends Fiero an invitation to a private museum tour and asks Evelyn for a favor, agreeing to owe her.
Anhelo gives Fiero a private tour of the museum, flattering him through the exhibits to the Old Capenna exhibit.
Anhelo tricks Fiero into standing in a spot where he cuts a wire and the Old Capennan Warrior's axe beheads him, leaving a warning in blood: death to traitors.
Running late to the wedding, Anhelo takes a cab driven by a man who locks the doors and takes him on a reckless drive.
events.quote: the locks clamped down on the doors.

events.summary: The driver reveals he is Severo, whose father Anhelo killed on his birthday three years ago, and drives into oncoming traffic.
events.quote: "It's Severo. And three years ago, you killed my father on my birthday,"

events.summary: A Riveteer transport crashes into the car; Anhelo stabs Severo and survives the wreck.
events.quote: A huge Riveteer transport crashed into them like an angry rhox.

events.summary: Riveteers who own the Halo in the trunk surround the battered Anhelo, who resolves to fight his way to the wedding.
Toluz appears with the shadow generator's darkness and wipes out the Riveteers, saving Anhelo.
events.quote: When it was all over, she was the only one left standing

events.summary: Toluz calls Anhelo family and has a healer and a new suit waiting for him in her limo.
Anhelo and Toluz arrive at Grand Capenna Hall, where Toluz offers him information free in the future and he declines.
events.quote: We can leave business for some other day."

events.summary: Anhelo dismisses a lackey reporting lost men at the Caldaia, saying the only family he cares about is in the bridal suite.
events.quote: the only family I care about is in that room.

events.summary: Anhelo reaches the bridal suite in time and is reunited with Errant on her wedding day.

relations.quote: And Errant marrying Toluz's daughter wasn't going to matter much if he upset her.
My daughter's been having trouble with him for years.

relations.note: Beheads Fiero with a trap in the museum.
Tries to hurt Anhelo's daughter's wedding day to avenge his father.
relations.quote: Hope your daughter hurts like I did.
"Yeah, I know the guy. One of ours.
I'd expect nothing else from a Maestro.
Obscura might not have much in the way of style

relations.note: They become allies through the weddings of their children.
They attack him over their Halo shipment.
relations.quote: Riveteers who had just run him off the road, and who wanted their merchandise back.
